Based on my search of the codebase, I found that the main event publishing functions are `emit()` and `emitAndForget()` in `src/lib/event-bus.ts`. The `emit()` function is the core publisher that publishes domain events onto the in-process event bus.

Let me verify the complete list by checking which source files call these functions:

From the structural search results, the production source files that call `emit()` (the event publisher) are:

1. src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts
2. src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts
3. src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts
4. src/server/services/billing-service.ts
5. src/server/services/comment-service.ts
6. src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts
7. src/server/services/invitation-service.ts
8. src/server/services/issue-service.ts
9. src/server/services/member-service.ts
10. src/server/services/organization-service.ts
11. src/server/services/project-service.ts
12. src/server/services/usage-service.ts

(Test files like `tests/lib/event-bus.test.ts`, `tests/services/activity-service.test.ts`, and `tests/services/notification-service.test.ts` also call `emit()`, but these are test utilities, not production publishers.)

ANSWER: src/app/api/webhooks/inbound/route.ts, src/server/jobs/overdue-issue-job.ts, src/server/jobs/trial-expiry-job.ts, src/server/services/billing-service.ts, src/server/services/comment-service.ts, src/server/services/feature-flag-service.ts, src/server/services/invitation-service.ts, src/server/services/issue-service.ts, src/server/services/member-service.ts, src/server/services/organization-service.ts, src/server/services/project-service.ts, src/server/services/usage-service.ts
